text:
Pipelex is an open-source language and runtime for building repeatable AI workflows. Instead of chaining prompts by hand, you describe each step's contract — its inputs, its output concept, and the instructions — and the runtime takes care of execution, validation, and structured outputs.

A method is a set of pipes declared in plain text files. Some pipes call a language model, some extract text from documents, and some run deterministic Python functions in a sandbox. Because the contract is explicit, the same method runs identically from the CLI, the API, or an agent.

This paragraph exists so the statistics have something to chew on: a few repeated words, a question or two, and punctuation. How many sentences does this text contain? Count them, then check the report against your own estimate!
